_note: One card per teacher, only with that teacher's written consent. The repo is public and git keeps history: put a card here only after consent. The consent text, a screenshot and its date stay 7 years in the owner's private sheet, by ref, never here. No credentials, years, rank, pay or numbers in role or line. A photo only with photoConsent: true (a separate consent to the photo). The block shows only with 3 or more cards. Field rules: README, 'Quotes and teacher cards'. Teacher consent request, send as is: אפשר להציג באתר כרטיס עם השם שלך והמשפט הזה (ותמונה)? זה רשות, לא משפיע על העבודה, ואפשר לבקש הסרה בכל עת.
